message: 聖者への道

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord. I can't make any progress in this game at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「You opened a treasure chest, didn't you? Doing that labels you a thief and lowers your virtue.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Rummaging through dressers and looting treasure chests are RPG staples, aren't they!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you're not a saint, you're a sage...」

name: Paqy
message: 「A uniform...? Working hard on a perfectly good Sunday, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we have preparations for the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, you probably just wanna see a certain someone anyway.」
He saw right through me.

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai might be coming too, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'll pass. Yours truly has a hotline straight to Ria-chan, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Acting like the president when you're just a plushie.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm?」

name: Synn
message: 「Coming~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello there~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!! Lolotte.\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe, I came over♪」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Could it be you came to pick me up...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Before heading to school, I really wanted to talk with you alone, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「What... just the two of us!?」
C-Could this possibly be...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, \{first|\s12\s12} I simply must tell you, President...」

name: Synn
message: 「That preface really makes me wonder, b-b-b-but got it! Hold on just a second!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy! A mirror, get me a mirror.\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not like you at all, suddenly starting to primp yourself up like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「You could at least cheer me on a little!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me is busy gaming. Now then, should I restart as a Ranger~」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though you're a sage!」
Inhale~~, exhale... Deep breath.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. Let's go!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, I've been waiting for you♪」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Hello~」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh~~. It was about the other angel.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It would be troublesome if it turned into too big of a commotion, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. It's not something one can confess unless they've steeled their resolve like I have.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see~~. Phew, that surprised me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What did you think it was about?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Your face is bright red.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Have you caught a cold? I've heard it's a nasty condition in the Human World triggered when it gets cold...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is that true!? That's terrible!」
Lolotte squeezes my hand tightly.
Enveloped by her soft hands, I...

name: Lolotte
message: 「If we stay like this, does it take the chill off a little?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y... Yeah. Quite a bit.\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe\s04 I feel warm and cozy too♪」
To think I'd get to walk holding hands with Lolotte!

name: Synn
message: 「It's just like love...」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No. Sure is nice weather today.\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. You're a funny President♪」
B-But doing this in front of Amyrina... really makes my heart pound.
Argh, this is kind of frustrating! Like I'm the only one getting embarrassed!

name: Amyrina
message: 「You mustn't, Lolotte\s01 The President's face has turned even brighter red!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauu!!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! I'm totally fine!」
Sigh... Lolotte's hand is so warm...

name: Synn
message: 「So, who is this other angel supposed to be, anyway?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please stay calm and listen, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The other angel. It's Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel is...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Azel...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. It may be hard to believe, but she is actually an angel.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see~~ So that's how it is.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Between us being angels and now this, you adapt far too easily, President.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Isn't that simply because the words are coming from you, Lolotte?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Synn
message: 「So we're going to ask Azel to help us with Re-Crea too, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Having more allies is always reassuring, after all!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-No. Anyway, let's head over. Since it's today, Amyrina can get in too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, I'll go call her♪」
Lolotte's hand slips away. Ah, how melancholy.

name: Amyrina
message: 「Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「Have you ever met Azel, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-No... However, it's a name I've heard somewhere before, so...」

name: Synn
message: 「You're both angels, so aren't you at least acquaintances?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「There aren't all that many angels, after all. I know most of them, yet...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte also said she met her for the first time in the Human World, so...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Perhaps she is a very high-ranking angel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel is?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「A noble existence whom the likes of us cannot meet. If someone like that were to become our ally--」

name: Synn
message: 「That'd be reassuring! Let's get her on our side no matter what!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh boy. Judging by that look...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems Azel-san isn't in.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Lolotte, what time is it now?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's past noon. I'm hungry~~」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's the case, the service is over. Knowing Azel, she's probably over there.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...! You're right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go to Prier for food afterward.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yaaay.\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She really was here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you whispering?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I didn't want to be noticed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are we pulling a prank or something?」

name: Azel
message: 「Leave.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I haven't even said anything yet!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Azel. I actually have some business with you--」

name: Azel
message: 「I have none with you.」
As always, there's no opening to get through to her.
Just as I was trying to figure out some way to get a conversation going.

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-You're...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina. Do you know Azel-san?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes. If my memory serves me right--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「An extraordinarily talented angel appointed to an important post at a young age.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Azel-san is one of the group tasked with investigating Re-Crea in the Human World!」

name: Synn
message: 「Re-Crea...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is that so?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're so knowledgeable, Amyrina~~. I had no idea at all.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You're just far too indifferent about matters in Heaven, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll reflect on that. From now on, I'll make sure to study up even on things I'm not interested in.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Trying to fix your flaws right away is so admirable of you, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「So heartwarming~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, this isn't the time for that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, that means Azel knows about Re-Crea too...」

name: Synn
message: 「So you came to Ryuusei Academy.」

name: Azel
message: 「It has nothing to do with you people.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes it does!! Up until now, we've been stopping the harm caused by Re-Crea as Crusaders. And going forward, too--」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no business with any of you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~~. You're saying that you can face the Re-Crea problem all by yourself, Azel-san. That is what you're claiming, yes.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's what you meant by that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Which means--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're a Crusader dispatched from Heaven, aren't you, Azel-san!?」

name: Azel
message: 「A Crusader?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I see. So that's what it was. That solves one mystery.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mystery...?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes. Considering the effects of Re-Crea, the investigation team should have already returned to Heaven.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be because of those ill effects...?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes. After all, it's safer for angels to lay low in Heaven.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「However, you stayed behind to do something about it! The riddle is solved!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just as I thought, you came here to protect the Human World, Azel-san!」

name: Azel
message: 「Protect... the Human World... you say?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Disregarding the danger threatening your own life, bravely and boldly confronting Re-Crea head-on! How admirable, Azel-san!」

name: Azel
message: 「Protect this world... you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To think we shared the same goal all along--it wouldn't be an exaggeration to call this a once-in-a-lifetime hair-trigger miracle!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now we can protect the Human World without any hesitation! Let's join forces and do our best together!」

name: Azel
message: 「Power... combine... protect...」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Lolotte. Something seems weird with Azel...」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... urgh...」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh... why... My own will is...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel...! Could it be, again...」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, 'again,' Lolotte... What's going on?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel!」
Lolotte caught Azel's staggering body.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... what's wrong...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Before.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Something similar happened before, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A time when Azel was suffering like this...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, you don't mean--」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm telling you... it's not... ngh.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I-Is this... the effect... of being in the Human World...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina. We should have already made up our minds about that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You must not be afraid. Because we are the ones who have to stand against Re-Crea.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Synn
message: 「For now, let's hurry to the infirmary...!」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't touch me!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Urgh... Stop... clinging to me any further.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san... Why do you reject us like this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aren't you hiding something?」

name: Azel
message: 「W-What are you saying...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How talkative you're being is the proof. We are comrades, so you don't need to keep secrets, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「Comrades, you say...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right!! Once you join us, Azel-san, the Crusaders will have the strength of a million men.」

name: Azel
message: 「Such a thing...」

name: Azel
message: 「...I can walk on my own now.」
Azel coldly pushed Lolotte away and turned her back.

name: Azel
message: 「Even I myself do not know what is happening here.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why, well, we should all think it over together--」

name: Azel
message: 「Then tell me the answer.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-That's... Not right away...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte is worried about you. You don't have to talk to her like that.」

name: Azel
message: 「Comrades... you say?」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no need for useless comrades.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...!」

name: Azel
message: 「Mind your own business. So...」

name: Azel
message: 「Never get involved with me again.」
